ctx.x: And where did he produce shows?

He produced shows over on the Sunset and across the street from the Sunset, I forget the name of what they call it. Club. There were two clubs, one right across the street from the other. Sunset and -- what the heck is the name of that club, where Carroll Dickerson Cal-Dixon had a band there. Forget the name of that club, I could never remember. But he was the producer of those shows in those clubs.
